mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals an impending economic slowdown that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in policy response.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth outpaces expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and rising), strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 100k) signals persistent inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as prolonged high interest rates are priced in.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and rising with PAYEMS > 100k, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) declining below 1000 thousand units signals a contraction in residential construction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced consumer spending and economic growth are priced in.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 245 combined with federal funds rate below 2.0% signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as persistent inflation erodes real returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 245 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding its 2017 base level (100) signals manufacturing recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger corporate earnings are anticipated.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
